spans.s: चण (I) a. (f. णा) (at the end of a compound) Renowned, famous for.
चण (I) a. (f. णा) (at the end of a compound) Renowned, famous for.
चणक m. The chick-pea, उच्छलितोऽपि हि चणको भ्राष्ट्रं भक्तुं न शक्नोति Panch.i.
चाणक्य m. Name of a celebrated writer on civil polity, otherwise known as विष्णुगुप्त. See कौटिल्य.
